eventDetail.scope: ISCIPT 2026 will serve as an international academic forum dedicated to the innovation, integration, and application of computer and information processing technologies. Its topic will cover four key tracks: Computer Science and Engineering (system design, embedded technology, architecture, SoC integration, cloud/edge computing, brain-machine interface); Machine Learning and Intelligent Computing (learning systems, deep learning applications, algorithm optimization, lightweight/distributed intelligent computing, multi-source fusion); Information Processing and Analysis (data mining, image/text analysis, big data processing); Information Transmission and Security (communication optimization, information/network security, data encryption, privacy protection). All aimed at gathering global researchers, engineers, and industry experts to share cutting-edge achievements, address cross-domain technical challenges, and advance innovation in these dynamic and evolving sectors.
